name: 17-fight-through-the-gym
objective: Into Pewter Gym, past its junior trainer, and beat Brock for the Boulder Badge.
evidence: badges>=1 counts the bits of wObtainedBadges $D356. At this point in the chain no other badge is reachable, so the count is bit 0, BIT_BOULDERBADGE.

VERIFIED BY DIFFING EVERY BYTE OF wEventFlags ($D747, 320 bytes) plus the badge bytes across the gym, not by transcription. Exactly five bytes move: $D356 wObtainedBadges $00 -> $01; $D72A wBeatGymFlags $00 -> $01; $D755 $00 -> $C4, whose three bits decode against constants/event_constants.asm as EVENT_BEAT_PEWTER_GYM_TRAINER_0 (bit 2), EVENT_GOT_TM34 (bit 6) and EVENT_BEAT_BROCK (bit 7); $D7EB $81 -> $00, whose two cleared bits are EVENT_1ST_ROUTE22_RIVAL_BATTLE and EVENT_ROUTE22_RIVAL_WANTS_BATTLE; and $D35E wCurMap. Every one of them is written by one block of the cartridge's own script, PewterGym.asm's .gymVictory, in that order - including the two clearings, which rearm the Route 22 rival encounter rather than losing progress.

THIS IS THE FIRST LINK IN THE CHAIN THAT HAS TO WIN A FIGHT. Every battle link before it has a goal the cartridge sets whoever won - HandlePlayerBlackOut special-cases the starter battle so link 05's flag is set after a loss as much as after a win, and the test rig measured the expert passing that link 300 of 300 while losing the fight up to 48% of the time. A badge bit only sets if Brock is beaten.

THE GYM'S JUNIOR TRAINER IS AVOIDABLE AND THE ROUTE AVOIDS HIM. Map $36's object data declares opponent 205 = 200 + class 5 (JR.TRAINER, roster 1: DIGLETT Lv11, SANDSHREW Lv11) at (3,6) facing right, and opponent 234 = 200 + class 34 (BROCK) at (4,1) facing down. Rows 3 and 9 of the gym are solid but for x=4 and x=5, so the straight climb up column 4 crosses his line at (4,6); column 1 runs from row 8 to row 4 entirely to his left. Both measured, 120 attempts each from the level-10 pool: fighting him 39/120 with 69 of 81 failures on his own tile, avoiding him 44/120 with every failure at Brock's.

NOT CERTIFIABLE AT THE CHAIN'S 99.9% BAR FOR ONE STARTER, and that is stated rather than hidden. 108 of 120 at the committed threshold, and the failures are one line: WARTORTLE 40/40, IVYSAUR 39/40, CHARMELEON 29/40. No reachable level fixes it - see the 15-train-for-brock evidence and docs/agent/brock.md section 10.
